# URL patterns skipped by every URL check, one per line. Lines starting with #
# and blank lines are ignored. A URL is skipped if it contains any pattern.
#
# Used by:
#   .github/workflows/linting.yaml            (PR check, site files)
#   scripts/check_added_urls.py               (PR check, URLs added to job files)
#   .github/workflows/clean-expired-jobs.yaml (nightly job board check)
#
# Add a pattern only for links that work in a browser but fail the checker,
# with a comment saying why. Fix or remove links that are really dead.

# Meeting and registration links expire after the event, but past event
# pages keep them as a record.
zoom.us

# Server sends an incomplete TLS certificate chain: browsers recover, but
# Python's requests fails certificate verification.
https://ai.eecs.umich.edu/people/conway/conway.html

# Archived snapshots don't disappear, and archive.org rate-limits CI servers
https://web.archive.org/

# Require a login (Slack) or block automated requests with a paywall or bot
# challenge, though the pages load in a browser
https://usrse.slack.com/
ieeexplore.ieee.org
cambridge.org
usatoday.com
usnews.com
